publishedRecipe.name: Pork Sausage "Cassoulet" with White Beans, Fennel & Thyme Bread Crumbs

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 fennel bulbs
2 yellow bell peppers
1 small pkg fresh thyme

instructions.primary_message: Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulbs. Halve fennel bulbs lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the fennel.
Peel, halve, and mince onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Add half to the bowl with the veggies. Mince remaining thyme leaves, place in a small bowl, and set aside for later use.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggie-thyme mixture and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp oregano, dried
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp rosemary, dried

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are done, add beans, tomato sauce, and water to the skillet. Stir to combine, then nestle sausages into the stew.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (8 oz) cans tomato sauce
1 cup water
4 pork sausages

instructions.primary_message: Place skillet in the oven and bake, turning sausages and stirring beans halfway through, until sausages are golden and cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, add bread crumbs to the bowl with the minced thyme and stir to combine.
To serve, divide cassoulet between plates or bowls and top with bread crumbs. Enjoy!
